title: Mich. Comp. Laws § 600.5805 — Personal actions
content:
Mich. Comp. Laws § 600.5805

(2) The period of limitations is 3 years after the time of the death or injury for all actions to recover damages for the death of a person, or for injury to a person or property.

title: Mich. Comp. Laws § 440.2725 — Statute of limitations in contracts for sale
content:
Mich. Comp. Laws § 440.2725

(1) An action for breach of any contract for sale must be commenced within 4 years after the cause of action has accrued. By the original agreement the parties may reduce the period of limitation to not less than 1 year but may not extend it.

title: Placek v. City of Sterling Heights, 405 Mich. 638 (1978)
shortTitle: Placek v. City of Sterling Heights
content:
Placek v. City of Sterling Heights, 405 Mich. 638 (1978).

[Excerpt — holding summary.]

The Supreme Court of Michigan held that governmental immunity does not bar claims arising from defects in public highways when the defect was known or should have been known to the municipality.

opinionParts.content: Governmental immunity does not bar highway defect claims when the defect was known or should have been known to the municipality.
